text.printed: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Choose a side scheme. That scheme loses each [acceleration], [amplify], [crisis], and [hazard] icon until the end of the round. If any icons were lost this way, place 1 all-purpose counter on an upgrade you control.
